name: episode_id
description: Primary key; deterministic ep_<sha256(external_ref)[:16]> for trigger-born episodes

name: external_ref
description: Trigger correlation id: the Cloud Logging insertId (or synth-<hash> for insertId-less entries). Equals defer_verification's unique_id and agent_executions.insert_id - THE join key to the harness table. Derived from deploy_event_json at export time

name: service_uid
description: Canonical identity svc://tenant/name/env/region; inferred*/ tenants are runtime candidates

name: fingerprint_json
description: Deterministic rollout fingerprint - the retrieval key for precedent matching

name: deploy_event_json
description: Parsed deploy event incl. external_ref and trigger provenance (DLP-scrubbed)

name: final_verdict
description: What the agent concluded: healthy | regression-suspected | insufficient-evidence

name: final_label
description: What reality proved: healthy | regressed | rolled_back - from outcomes/humans, never from agent verdicts

name: exported_at
description: Snapshot upload time (microsecond precision); the *_latest views key on it

name: export_phase
description: ladder_complete (final verdict recorded) | outcome_final (re-export after ground-truth labeling)

name: export_session
description: Harness session that ran the export
